- **EMET:** Judge the-weak and-the-fatherless; the-afflicted and-the-destitute vindicate.
- **LOGOS:** Give justice to the weak and the fatherless; maintain the right of the afflicted and the destitute.
- **PNEUMA:** Stand up for the helpless and the orphan! See that the poor and oppressed get justice!
